title: Bounded-degree coboundary expanders in every dimension
summary: For every integer d ≥ 3, we construct arbitrarily large finite d -dimensional simplicial complexes with uniformly bounded vertex degrees and uniform 𝔽 2 coboundary expansion in every degree below d . Together with the known graph and two-dimensional cases, this establishes the existence of bounded-degree 𝔽 2 coboundary expanders in every positive dimension.

review.reason: Constructs bounded-degree coboundary expanders in every dimension, extending known graph cases.
